title: Projection mates descend along non-Cartesian compactification refinements
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{k_0}$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $t$; put $A_n=R/(t^n)$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], not a datum assuming projection invertibility. Schemes are finite type over $k$ and their structure morphisms need not be separated. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and the specified compactification projection map [def-exchange-projection], with compact-support functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, $K\in D^b_c(X,A_n)$ arbitrary and $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A_n)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. For compactifications $c_i=(j_i,p_i)$ and a proper refinement $a:c_1\to c_2$, put
$$\theta_a=R_{p_2}(\gamma_a^{-1})c_{p_2,a}$$
with exactly the comparison of [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism]. The proper/open comparison $\gamma_a$ uses the clopen-projection normalization of [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate], including non-Cartesian refinement squares. Then
$$\theta_{a,K\otimes^LLf^*L}\operatorname{PF}^{c_1}_{f,K,L}=\operatorname{PF}^{c_2}_{f,K,L}(\theta_{a,K}\otimes1_L).$$
Both $K$ and $K\otimes^LLf^*L$ are bounded constructible and admit etale-origin witnesses; hence the compactification comparisons apply to both, without imposing finite Tor amplitude on $K$. The common-refinement cocycle [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] makes these maps descend to a natural transformation independent of compactification. The local equality used here also holds before evaluation for actual semilinear-system proper/open maps in [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]; it is an equality of system composites, without detecting maps from their finite evaluations.

proof.text: Apply tensor_and_origins. Its first clause supplies origins for K and, after its tensor-closure clause, for T=K tensor Lf*L. These are precisely the three domain assertions of finite_descent.
Use refinement_square for every proper refinement. The witnessed normalized comparison family and its cocycle are supplied by comparison_cocycle.

Choose a base compactification and restrict its actual projection natural transformation to the full pair domain to define tau. For any other compactification take a common refinement and apply the single-refinement square to both legs. Precompose with the tensor of the first comparison, use that square and cancel its inverse on T, then use the second square. Functoriality cancels the inverse comparison on K. The normalization of rho identifies these composites with the two components of rho(c,c0), proving the displayed tau equation. No projection arrow is inverted. The cancellation is proved first as a private generic coefficient-ring identity and then specialized, retaining the exact native projection components.

The intrinsic system theorem is the existing properOpenProjectionMateSystems specialized to the same refinement square with identity left proper map. It retains all identity pull/push and composition comparisons and is an equality in the actual semilinear-system category before evaluation. The realizations remain those of IntegralCompactificationSystemRealization, without enlarging their common-bound or etale-origin domain.

theorem finite_descent (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[C.l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[C.l] E]
    (n : ℕ) (_S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    (∀ (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
      (L : (finiteTor C.l E n Y).FullSubcategory),
      boundedConstructible C.l E n X (tensorInput C.l E n f K.obj L.obj) ∧
      (∃ O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X,
        Nonempty (refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X O ≅
          K.obj)) ∧
      (∃ OT : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X,
        Nonempty (refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X OT ≅
          tensorInput C.l E n f K.obj L.obj))) ∧
    (∀ (c d : Compactification f) (r : c.Refinement d)
      (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
      (L : (finiteTor C.l E n Y).FullSubcategory),
      refinementLaw C.l E n c d r K L) ∧
    ∃ rho : ∀ c d : Compactification f,
        (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).ι ⋙ image C.l E n c ≅
          (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).ι ⋙ image C.l E n d,
      (∀ (c d b : Compactification f) (r : b.Refinement c) (s : b.Refinement d)
        (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
        (O : RefinementFiniteLevelOrigin C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X)
        (e : refinementFiniteLevelFixedObject C.l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) X O ≅ K.obj),
        (rho c d).app K = (theta C.l E n r K.obj O e).symm ≪≫
          theta C.l E n s K.obj O e) ∧
      (∀ c d b : Compactification f, rho c d ≪≫ rho d b = rho c b) ∧
      ∀ c₀ : Compactification f,
        ∃ tau : source C.l E n c₀ ⟶ target C.l E n c₀,
          ∀ (c : Compactification f)
            (K : (boundedConstructible C.l E n X).FullSubcategory)
            (L : (finiteTor C.l E n Y).FullSubcategory)
            (hT : boundedConstructible C.l E n X (tensorInput C.l E n f K.obj L.obj)),
          coefficientProjectionComponent (Coefficient C.l E n) c K.obj L.obj ≫
            (rho c c₀).hom.app ⟨tensorInput C.l E n f K.obj L.obj, hT⟩ =
          ((ProperOpenTensor (Coefficient C.l E n) Y).map ((rho c c₀).hom.app K)).app
              L.obj ≫ tau.app (K, L)
